sources.label: Official Tommy Hilfiger women's size guide (Tommy Hilfiger sizes: Dress / Skirts / Jumpsuit chart, cm)

audit: Old URL uk.tommy.com/en/size-guide is an error page; guide is now at /womens-size-guide. Stored chart was single values for XS-2XL only; official chart is cm ranges XXS-7XL (UK 4-26). Letter-to-UK mapping unchanged (XS = UK 6). M (UK 10) bust 90 -> 88.5-92.5, waist 71 -> 72-76, hips 95 -> 97-101; XL (UK 14) bust 98 -> 96.5-101.5, waist 79 -> 81-86, hips 103 -> 105-110. Same chest/waist/hips as the Coats/Jackets chart. Tommy Jeans and Tommy Sport charts differ and are not included. Notes corrected: removed "US sizing" (the UK guide gives UK/US/EU per alpha size) and "consistent sizing across collections" (Tommy Jeans and Sport charts differ).
notes: Alpha sizes XXS–7XL, which the UK guide maps to UK 4–26 (XS = UK 6, M = UK 10). Preppy American heritage cut — slightly relaxed, comfortable fit. Denim, polos and outerwear are popular secondhand picks. Tommy Jeans and Tommy Sport use their own, different charts.
